Create a stylized post-apocalyptic supermarket scene presented as a roofless cutaway, with a shop floor, surrounding walls, broken front windows, and an entrance facing an open forecourt. Arrange two parallel rows of retail shelves inside the shop, separated by a broad central aisle connecting the entrance to the rear of the shop. Place checkout counters just inside the entrance and beverage coolers and frozen-goods freezers along the rear wall. Keep some shelves bare. Place a sparse assortment of groceries on the other shelves. Include cans, milk bottles, pasta boxes, and food packages among these groceries. Put metal storage racks and stacked boxes in one rear corner. Cluster abandoned shopping carts near the entrance. Mount a large market sign above the entrance and place a freestanding market sign in the forecourt. Set parking stops and traffic cones along the forecourt edges. Scatter small garbage piles, a trash bin, and discarded tires around the outer perimeter. Add grass and small trees along the outer edges of the site. Give the scene worn surfaces and muted colors. Use clear daylight. Keep circulation routes open throughout the abandoned shop.

Place a sparse assortment of groceries on the other shelves. Include cans, milk bottles, pasta boxes, and food packages among these groceries. Mount a large market sign above the entrance and place a freestanding market sign in the forecourt. Set parking stops and traffic cones along the forecourt edges.
